name: Timothy Omundson
bio: Timothy Michael Omundson (born July 29, 1969) is a European-American actor. He is notable for his supporting roles as Sean Potter on the CBS television series Judging Amy, Eli on the syndicated series Xena: Warrior Princess, Carlton Lassiter in Psych, as King Richard on the musical series Galavant, and as Cain in Supernatural.
